info.title: Finance Dashboard API
info.description: Private read-only API. Dates are UTC. Values are display-oriented IEEE-754 numbers, null when unavailable. Prices are stored unadjusted snapshots. No live provider requests. Growth is (current-previous)/abs(previous), comparing matching periods and currencies in consecutive fiscal years.
